deposit_range.description: Security deposit must be between 1.0 and 2.0 months of the agreed base monthly rent.

notice_period_range.description: Notice period for lease termination or non-renewal must be between 30 and 60 days.

required_clauses.title: Maintenance Responsibility
required_clauses.description: Must clearly define maintenance duties: Landlord is responsible for structural integrity, roofs, exterior walls, and major mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems. Tenant is responsible for routine cleanliness, minor interior maintenance, and reporting defects promptly.

required_clauses.title: Return of Deposit Timeline
required_clauses.description: Must specify that the security deposit will be returned within 14 to 30 calendar days following full vacancy, accompanied by an itemized written statement of any lawful deductions.

required_clauses.title: Renewal Terms
required_clauses.description: Must specify clear renewal procedures, requiring at least 30 to 60 days advance written notice by either party prior to expiration, and prohibiting unnotified automatic multi-year renewal locks.

required_clauses.title: Subletting Policy
required_clauses.description: Must define the subletting and assignment rules, establishing that subleasing or assignment is permitted subject to obtaining the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.

forbidden_terms.title: Waiver of Statutory Habitability or Structural Repairs
forbidden_terms.description: Any clause requiring the tenant to waive statutory warranties of habitability, or forcing the tenant to assume sole financial and physical responsibility for pre-existing structural defects, foundation, or main utility infrastructure repairs.

forbidden_terms.title: Excessive Late Rent Penalties
forbidden_terms.description: Any penalty for delinquent rent exceeding 5% of the base monthly rent, or any provision imposing compounding daily penalty fees that exceed statutory or fair practice limits.

forbidden_terms.title: Unilateral Immediate Eviction and Judicial Waiver
forbidden_terms.description: Any clause purporting to allow the landlord to lock out the tenant, remove tenant possessions, or terminate occupancy immediately without statutory advance written notice and formal judicial process.
